wholeSourceCell.sourceRef: Rahmenlehrplan Berlin-Brandenburg Gymnasiale Oberstufe Teil C Chemie 2022, 3.2.1 Proteine, S. 28; Verbindlichkeits- und GK/LK-Regel S. 26.

proposedPartialEdge.courseLevelRationale: Original p26 binding rule and p28 GK column; LK explicitly additional to GK.

judgments.reason: The original p28 Ninhydrin experiment supplies the amino-acid/free-amino-group assay component of currentwhole5c. This is not a uniquely selective test for free amino acids in every mixed protein sample, and no universal colour/absence claim is inferred. Physical26 explicitly makes the listed experiments compulsory for GK and inherited by LK, allowing equipment-based variation only if the intended experiment demand remains. The p29 food-use contribution corroborates a possible context, not a mandatory whole food-panel competence. The neighbouring protein denaturation experiment remains a distinct duty. One assay cell is only PARTIAL to the whole amino-acid-and-peptide execution/inference competence; no whole course or actual performed experiment is approved.
